crossRefs.note: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
“Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

translations.web: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
translations.bsb: The memory of him perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the land.
translations.kjv: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
translations.asv: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name in the street.
